nodes.text: Reports say that HMPV virus has been detected in an eight-year old kid in Bengaluru. It's PR work of those who want India to be disrupted. HMPV exists in India since long. Govt & people shouldn't budge. It's an elaborate & a sinister plan of China & big pharma. No one must care.
